tools.name: list_launches
tools.title: List token launches
tools.description: List the token launch calls the OurBlast X bot has detected, with the parsed ticker, name, launchpad, status and transaction links. Same data as the public launch status page.

limit.description: How many launches to return, newest first.

status.description: Optional status filter, e.g. PENDING, LAUNCHING, DEPLOYED, FAILED.

tools.name: get_launch
tools.title: Get launch status
tools.description: Look up one token launch by its ticker (e.g. HMMM) or the X post id it came from, including the original tweet text and any on-chain transaction digest.

symbol.description: Token ticker, with or without the leading $.

xPostId.description: The X post id the launch call came from.

tools.name: list_launchpads
tools.title: List launchpads
tools.description: List the Sui launch platforms OurBlast can target and whether each one is integrated yet, with supply and liquidity ranges.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.title: Get arcade leaderboard
tools.description: Get the OurBlast arcade leaderboard: top community members by points, with games played and best score.

tools.name: list_builders
tools.title: List top builders
tools.description: List the top OurBlast builders ranked by builder score, with their GitHub handle, verified repositories, commits and Sui reputation.
